call_points.text: Europe targets high-teens EBITDA margin on full-year basis once footprint shift completes.
Q1 consolidated capex ₹650 Cr; net debt/EBITDA 0.4x; expects net debt/EBITDA to rise slightly this year.
Hungary PCR capacity expanding by 4,000 tyres/day, production to start H2FY27; India expansion to start end-FY27.
India volume growth: replacement 13%, OEM 10%, exports 15%; July demand strong, expects momentum into Q2.
Other expenses reduced QoQ, mainly advertisement and sales promotion cut by ~50%; no further reduction expected.
Europe agri business declined high-teens QoQ; offtake arrangement for high-end agri tyres to continue mid-term.
U.S. market underperformed due to dealer inventory issues; West Asia impacted by war.
Raw material costs expected to rise in mid to high teens sequentially, prompting 6% to 8% price hikes.
